title: Inter's Esposito hits 10 Italy goals at 21. Start him over Lautaro?
caption:
Inter's Francesco Pio Esposito scored his 10th goal for Italy in Sunday's 4–1 loss in Brussels, per Inter.it — 10 in 15 games, and only Giuseppe Meazza got to ten younger. Meanwhile Lautaro Martínez rejoins group training this week, per Gazzetta dello Sport. Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.
